why: Daniel drops spelled-out clarifications and uses the spelling ("it's spelled D-A-V-E-N" -> "Daven"); only a handful in his edits.
behaviour: the speaker spells out one or two names or unusual words letter by letter for the transcriber ("that's Daven, D-A-V-E-N", "it's spelled K-O-B-I", "Shira with an S-H"), sometimes after the recogniser has written the word wrongly
rule: When the speaker spells a word out, write the word with that spelling (capitalised if it is a name) wherever it appears, and drop the spelling and the "it's spelled" phrase entirely.
